resources.string: Choose your iPhone and bring CarPlay to this screen.
Use the car’s USB data port
The app creates a temporary network. Keep the car’s Wi-Fi and Bluetooth on.
Use the car’s existing hotspot. Its name and password must match the saved details.
Select a wireless method, pair your iPhone, then connect.
Connection progress and recovery options appear here.
Turn on Wi-Fi in the car settings, then return and connect again.
Turn on the car hotspot. Check its name and password in Connection method before reconnecting.
Allow Nearby devices, and precise Location on older Android versions, in app permissions. Then reconnect.
Return to automatic channel selection, or choose another supported channel in Connection method.
The car rejected network creation. Check Wi-Fi and close other projection apps. If this continues, try the car hotspot or USB.
Another Wi-Fi Direct group is present
Close other projection apps, then use the reset option to clear the group and reconnect.
Use the car hotspot or connect through the USB data port.
Unlock your iPhone, enable Bluetooth and Wi-Fi, and check pairing with the car.
Save the current name, password and security type from the car hotspot settings.
CarPlay will retry automatically. You can also review the connection method or return home.
Manage receiver controls and vehicle extensions.
Car hotspot is off · Open car settings to continue
